name: luxury-medical-motion-ads
description: Use when making a luxury medical or clinic advertising video or motion graphic (Arabic or English): ad spots, reels, stories, service promos, health-education and organ/3D medical explainers, and every Hidden Impact (مركز الأثر الخفي) video — with Saudi voice-over, cinematic + 3D medical scenes, music/SFX, captions and mandatory brand logo.
